body:
Channel Link: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCZiLSyR0TYZk9PaO4GC1JSQ
Discord Tag: Rilo#5735
Subscriber/Follower count: 226
Any other information you want to share: This is my second application for Content Creator. My first was denied because I haven't uploaded in over 2 weeks. I spoke to Posighdun and he said if I uploaded 1 more video I could reapply. So here I am, reapplying (https://gyazo.com/d6fb798709352c0810a7bac54cd285cd). I want to be Content Creator so I can make videos for the Avicus Network. I haver never been endorsed for an Avicus rank, and I am trying to get 1 so I can help, not the reason for 'just simply having a rank'. I have been an active member of this community for well over 3 years now, trying out for every opportunity. I have a few videos in the making, and I am not planning to stop any time. I can create videos whenever necessary and can help others out in need. I know I am not 1 of those amazing spectacular flashing light effect editors. because that's not what you're looking for (hopefully). My editing is satisfactory and I could make it better if I have to. I really want to help out with this rank, more than any other. 

-Rilo
